headline: BOS @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 2.76 at ATL 4.01, with a projected total of 6.77. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: BOS moved -1.83 runs while ATL moved -1.35, changing the projected margin by -0.48 runs. The projected total fell -3.17, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Bryce Elder has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Drake Baldwin, Ceddanne Rafaela, Matt Olson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ozzie Albies, Jarren Duran because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
